Ramayana Part 1 Trailer Scripts History; Clocks 1+ Billion Views Across All Languages
Mumbai, August 6 - The trailer of director Nitesh Tiwari's Ramayana: Part 1 has scripted history by crossing 1 billion cumulative views across all platforms and languages, becoming the first Indian film trailer to achieve the remarkable milestone. The record underlines the unprecedented anticipation surrounding the historical epic, which is already being hailed as one of the biggest cinematic events in Indian film history. (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}) The achievement comes within days of the trailer's launch, making it one of the fastest and most-watched promotional campaigns ever mounted for an Indian film. The biggest contributor to this historic feat has been the Hindi trailer, which alone has amassed an astonishing 588 million views on the World of Ramayana Instagram account, on which overall viewership across languages is around 750 million. In addition, the trailer has generated hundreds of millions of views across YouTube, Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, and other digital platforms in multiple Indian and international languages. Combined, the cumulative viewership has now comfortably crossed the one-billion mark, setting a new benchmark that no Indian film trailer has achieved before. (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}) Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana: Part 1 features an ensemble cast led by Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Ram, Sai Pallavi as Sita, Yash as Ravana, Sunny Deol as Hanuman, and Ravi Dubey as Lakshman. The trailer has received widespread acclaim for its spectacular visuals, cutting-edge VFX, grand scale, and the powerful musical collaboration between Hans Zimmer and A. R. Rahman. The makers have also expanded the film's global reach by releasing the trailer in multiple languages, including an English version powered by AI-assisted lip-sync technology. Produced by Namit Malhotra in association with Yash's Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana: Part 1 is scheduled to release worldwide on November 6, 2026, during the Diwali festive season. With its trailer now setting an unprecedented digital record of over one billion views, the film has further strengthened its position as one of the most anticipated Indian releases of all time. Ajay Devgn's Golmaal 5 Reportedly Replaces Ranger In December 2026 Clash; Akshay Kumar's Comedy May Also Shift
Mumbai, August 6 - Bollywood star Ajay Devgn is reportedly reshuffling his release calendar, setting up one of the biggest box office battles of 2026. Devgn's jungle adventure Ranger has reportedly been postponed to 2027, with Golmaal 5 taking over its December 4, 2026 release date, according to Variety India. If the report proves accurate, the Rohit Shetty directorial will lock horns with Prabhas' Fauzi and Akshay Kumar's untitled comedy entertainer directed by Anees Bazmee. (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}) The reshuffle significantly raises the stakes for the December corridor. While Golmaal 5 and Akshay Kumar's yet-to-be-titled film belong to the comedy genre, Fauzi, directed by Hanu Raghavapudi, is a large-scale period action drama led by Prabhas. The clash would offer audiences two commercial comedies against a pan-India action spectacle, making it one of the most diverse and highly anticipated box office battles in recent years. However, Golmaal 5's arrival (if official) could also trigger another major release change. Akshay Kumar is playing a major role in Rohit Shetty's comedy alongside Ajay Devgn. Releasing two Akshay Kumar-led commercial entertainers on the same day would split both the actor's fanbase and the comedy audience, making it an unlikely scenario. As a result, Anees Bazmee's untitled film is also a strong candidate to move to another release date, although no official decision has been announced yet. (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}) If that happens, Prabhas' Fauzi could be left facing only Golmaal 5, turning the clash into a battle between one of Indian cinema's biggest comedy franchises and one of the country's biggest pan-India stars. Golmaal 5 boasts an ensemble cast featuring Ajay Devgn, Akshay Kumar, Arshad Warsi, Shreyas Talpade, Tusshar Kapoor, Kunal Kemmu and Sharman Joshi, who returns to the franchise after appearing in the original Golmaal: Fun Unlimited (2006). Meanwhile, Fauzi stars Prabhas alongside Imanvi, Anupam Kher, Mithun Chakraborty, Bhanu Chander and Jayapradha. The film carries high expectations following director Hanu Raghavapudi's critically acclaimed Sita Ramam and Prabhas' massive pan-India fan base. On the other hand, Akshay Kumar's untitled comedy with Anees Bazmee also stars Vidya Balan and Raashii Khanna. While the release calendar is yet to be officially finalised, the coming weeks are expected to bring clarity on whether Bollywood will witness a three-way blockbuster clash or another round of strategic postponements.
Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2 CBFC Certificate and Theatrical Runtime Details Revealed
Mumbai, August 5 - With just days remaining for its theatrical release, Emraan Hashmi's Awarapan 2 has completed its censor formalities. The much-awaited sequel to the 2007 cult classic has been certified by the Central Board of Film Certification (CBFC), clearing the final hurdle before hitting cinemas on August 14. According to the latest certification details, Awarapan 2 has been awarded a U/A 16+ certificate after the CBFC suggested a handful of minor modifications. The board reportedly asked the makers to tone down one violent sequence by 50%, remove three instances of extreme violence, and delete a scene featuring drug consumption. Following these changes, the film received its censor certificate on August 5. (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}) The official runtime of Awarapan 2 has also been locked at 140.20 minutes, which translates to 2 hours, 20 minutes and 20 seconds. The duration suggests that the makers have opted for a fairly expansive narrative, balancing action, romance, and emotional drama. Trade observers believe the runtime is well-suited for the film's musical action-drama format. Directed by Nitin Kakkar, Awarapan 2 stars Emraan Hashmi, Disha Patani, and Shabana Azmi in key roles. The film serves as the long-awaited sequel to the original Awarapan, which has gained cult status over the years thanks to its music, emotional storytelling, and Hashmi's memorable performance as Shivam. The makers are set to unveil the film's theatrical trailer on August 6, further intensifying anticipation ahead of its worldwide release on August 14.
Dorothy Teaser Unveiled as Karthik Subbaraj's 10th Film Heads to TIFF and September Release
Dhanush has officially unveiled the teaser for Karthik Subbaraj's highly anticipated tenth directorial venture, titled Dorothy. The announcement comes with a significant achievement, as the film has been selected for the prestigious Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF). This international recognition before its theatrical release highlights the global appeal of Subbaraj's unique storytelling style and marks a proud moment for Tamil cinema on the world stage. Scheduled for a worldwide release on September 25, 2026, the film is now moving toward its theatrical window Karthik Subbaraj has built a reputation over the last decade as a filmmaker who consistently subverts genre expectations. Since his breakout debut with the low-budget horror hit Pizza, he has delivered a string of cult classics and commercial successes. His filmography includes the acclaimed gangster-satire Jigarthanda, the high-octane Rajinikanth starrer Petta, and the more recent western-inspired period drama Jigarthanda DoubleX. Dorothy serves as a milestone project for the director, representing ten films of creative experimentation and genre-bending narratives. (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}) The teaser and promotional posters suggest a visually striking and atmospheric experience. The monochromatic design featuring a bold red circle and characters on bicycles hints at a period or rural noir setting. A major highlight of this project is the collaboration between Subbaraj and the legendary composer Ilaiyaraaja. The pairing of the modern auteur’s stylized visuals with the timeless musical sensibilities of Isaignani Ilaiyaraaja has created immense curiosity among cinephiles. The cast is led by National Award winner Keerthy Suresh, who is known for her range in performance-heavy roles. She is joined by Sananth and Rishikanth, both of whom have previously collaborated with the director. On the production side, the film is backed by a powerhouse combination of Jio Studios and Guneet Monga's Sikhya Entertainment. Monga, an Academy Award-winning producer, brings a level of international expertise that aligns with the film’s presence at TIFF, ensuring that the project receives significant global visibility. 'The Gauntlet Has Been Passed' – Russo Brothers Hail Spider-Man: Brand New Day Box Office Triumph
Mumbai, August 5 - Spider-Man: Brand New Day continues to rewrite history, and its massive box office triumph has earned praise from none other than Anthony and Joe Russo. The acclaimed filmmakers behind Avengers: Endgame publicly congratulated the cast and crew after the Tom Holland starrer shattered the domestic opening weekend record previously held by their 2019 blockbuster, calling it a symbolic passing of the torch for Marvel's biggest theatrical success. Following its sensational debut, Spider-Man: Brand New Day delivered an unprecedented $360 million opening weekend in North America, edging past Avengers: Endgame's $357.1 million record. The film has also become the biggest Hollywood opener ever in India, collecting approximately 308.50 crore gross during its opening weekend, while crossing the $1 billion worldwide milestone in just six days, making it the second-fastest film in history to reach the landmark. (adsbygoogle = window.adsbygoogle || []).push({}) Taking to Instagram, the Russo Brothers shared a celebratory artwork by BossLogic featuring Spider-Man wielding the Infinity Stones. Alongside the artwork, they wrote, "Huge congratulations to Destin, Tom, Zendaya, Jacob, Jon, Mark, Sadie, Florence, Michael, Marisa, producers Kevin, Amy, Avi, and Rachel, and the entire Spider-Man: Brand New Day cast and crew on making domestic box office opening weekend history. The gauntlet has been passed." Their message has been widely viewed as a gracious acknowledgement of Marvel's newest record-breaking blockbuster. Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton, Brand New Day has emerged as one of the biggest theatrical events in cinema history. While Avengers: Endgame still holds the record for the highest worldwide opening weekend and remains one of the highest-grossing films ever, Brand New Day has firmly established itself among the MCU's all-time biggest successes. With exceptional audience reception and strong weekday collections across global markets, the film is expected to continue its remarkable run and add even more box office milestones in the weeks ahead. Kantara surpasses KGF 1 to become second highest-grossing Kannada film of all time
Rishab Shetty's Kantara has surpassed Yash's KGF: Chapter 1 to climb to the second spot in the list of highest-grossing Kannada films of all time.
Published on: Oct 28, 2022, 17:07:51 IST
Rishab Shetty’s Kantara has broken new ground at the box office. It has become only the third Kannada film ever to cross the ₹250-crore mark in global box office gross earnings. In the process, it has also surpassed KGF: Chapter 1 to become the second-highest-grossing Kannada film ever. Only KGF: Chapter 2 remains ahead of it now and that may be too big a mountain to climb for the film. Also read: Kantara impact: Karnataka govt announces allowance for Daiva Narthakas in state
Kantara started slowly but over time, it has generated quite a buzz through word of mouth, minting money week after week. As per trade sources, it crossed The ₹250-crore mark in global earnings on Thursday. Trade tracker Sacnilk puts its worldwide earnings at ₹251 crore now. This is slightly higher than Yash-starrer KGF: Chapter 1’s lifetime earning of ₹250 crore. In the list of highest-grossing Kannada films of all time, KGF: Chapter 2 sits pretty at the top with a massive haul of ₹1207 crore.
No matter how much business Kantara does from now on, that figure is one too far even for this film. This is still a big achievement for the film, which was made on a reported ₹15-crore budget and was not expected to even reach the ₹100-crore mark. Kantara is also among the highest grossing Indian films of 2022 in all languages. It sits at the seventh spot in that list, behind KGF 2, RRR, Ponniyin Selvan I, Vikram, Brahmastra Part One Shiva, and Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2.
Kantara is set in coastal Karnataka and is an action thriller with links to the local faith and folklore. Rishab Shetty has directed and starred in it as well. The film has received critical acclaim apart from commercial success. It is currently the highest-rated Indian film on IMDB with an impressive score of 9.4 out of 10.

Kannada cinema produces films in Kannada language. The 1965 film Satya Harishchandra was the first Kannada film to cross ₹1 crore. The 1995 film Om was the first Kannada film to cross ₹10 crores. Mungaru Male was the first Kannada film to cross ₹50 crores. Raajakumara was the first Kannada movie to cross ₹75 crore mark. From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Kannada cinema is a part of Indian cinema based in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The films are made primarily in Kannada-language. The 2006 film Mungaru Male is the first Kannada movie to gross ₹50 crores. The 2017 film Raajakumara is the first Kannada movie to gross ₹75 crore mark.
KGF: Chapter 1 (2018) is the first Kannada film to achieve ₹100, ₹150, ₹200 and ₹250 crore gross milestone. Its sequel KGF: Chapter 2 (2022) is the first Kannada film to achieve ₹500, ₹750, ₹1,000 and ₹1,250 crore gross milestones. Kantara: Chapter 1 (2025) was reported to be the first film to gross over ₹200 crore as well as ₹250 crore within Karnataka. This ranking lists the highest-grossing Kannada films which are filmed in Kannada language, based on conservative global box office estimates as reported by organisations classified as green by Wikipedia.[a] However, there is no official tracking of figures.
Background shading indicates that a film is currently showing in theatres worldwide.

Roberrt (2021) is excluded from the list because three years after its theatrical run, the producer admitted to have fabricated its collections and had inflated the figures earlier; revealing the actual collection to be only ₹55 crores as against the trade estimate of 78 crores at the time of its release.

results.title: Highest-grossing Kannada films of all time: From ‘KGF: Chapter 2’ to ‘Kantara', movies that ruled the global box office
results.content:
Highest-grossing Kannada films of all time: From ‘KGF: Chapter 2’ to ‘Kantara', movies that ruled the global box office
Highest-grossing Kannada films of all time: From ‘KGF: Chapter 2’ to ‘Kantara', movies that ruled the global box office
TOI Entertainment Desk / ETimes.in / Mar 16, 2026, 12:40 IST
Highest-grossing Kannada films of all time
Over the last decade, the Kannada film industry has witnessed an impressive transformation, with several films crossing regional boundaries and becoming massive nationwide and global hits. From visually grand action spectacles to rooted storytelling, Kannada cinema has produced multiple box office juggernauts that have impressed audiences worldwide.
Blockbusters such as ‘KGF: Chapter 2’ and ‘Kantara’ have not only shattered records but also brought unprecedented attention to the industry. These films, along with several others, have secured their place among the highest-grossing Kannada movies ever made. Here’s a closer look at the Kannada films that dominated the worldwide box office.
The biggest blockbuster in Kannada cinema history, ‘KGF: Chapter 2’ turned into a worldwide sensation upon its release in 2022. Directed by Prashanth Neel, the action-packed sequel stars Yash in the iconic role of Rocky Bhai. The film also features Sanjay Dutt as the menacing villain Adheera, along with Raveena Tandon, Srinidhi Shetty and Prakash Raj in key roles. According to industry tracker Sacnilk, mounted on a massive scale, the film’s gripping narrative and powerful performances helped it earn around Rs 1,215 crore globally.
‘Kantara: A Legend - Chapter 1’
The prequel to the blockbuster ‘Kantara’, this ambitious mythological drama further expanded the cinematic universe created by Rishab Shetty. Directed by and starring Shetty himself, the film dives deeper into the folklore and traditions of coastal Karnataka. With grand visuals and rooted storytelling, the film reportedly collected around Rs 851.89 crore at the global box office, making it one of the most successful Kannada films ever.
Released in 2022, ‘Kantara’ became a cultural phenomenon across India. Written, directed and headlined by Rishab Shetty, the film also stars Sapthami Gowda and Kishore in pivotal roles. Set against the backdrop of traditional beliefs and land conflicts, the film blended folklore with intense drama, eventually grossing around Rs 407.82 crore worldwide.
Before the massive success of its sequel, ‘KGF: Chapter 1’ laid the foundation for the franchise’s global popularity. Directed by Prashanth Neel, the film introduced audiences to Yash’s powerful portrayal of Rocky Bhai. The film also starred Srinidhi Shetty, Anant Nag and Ramachandra Raju, earning around Rs 238 crore worldwide and paving the way for the sequel’s historic run.
Directed by Kiranraj K, ‘777 Charlie’ is a heartfelt adventure drama starring Rakshit Shetty alongside a dog named Charlie. The film also features Sangeetha Sringeri and Raj B Shetty in important roles. Praised for its emotional storytelling and universal appeal, the movie earned about Rs 102.75 crore worldwide.
‘Vikrant Rona’, directed by Anup Bhandari, stars Kichcha Sudeepa in the lead role. The fantasy action thriller also features Nirup Bhandari, Neetha Ashok and Jacqueline Fernandez in a special appearance. With its visually striking presentation and mystery-driven narrative, the film collected around Rs 100.35 crore globally.DISCLAIMER: Figures presented in this article are derived from various public sources and are considered approximate unless explicitly noted.
